title: Define Memory Tensor RT Operator Scaffold
purpose: Add the first formal operator scaffold for the memory tensor RT induction so later math, neuroscience, and simulation work can share the same primitives.

operator_chain.name: Real Truth
operator_chain.definition: The entire expression as one; the complete relational condition within which all local operations occur.

operator_chain.name: Tensor Array
operator_chain.definition: The individual's memory RT expressed as an array of gradients rather than stored memory objects.

operator_chain.name: Coupling
operator_chain.definition: The coupling type that establishes the operative identity-position from which orientation can arise.

operator_chain.name: Orientation
operator_chain.definition: The active directional condition through the tensor array, arising from the present coupling condition.

operator_chain.name: Slice
operator_chain.definition: The locally selected section of the tensor array made available under the active orientation.

operator_chain.name: Trajectory
operator_chain.definition: The traversal path through the selected tensor slice.

operator_chain.name: Resolution
operator_chain.definition: The local gradient resolution that produces a practical recall output and associated confidence.

operator_chain.name: Memory
operator_chain.definition: The practical memory output produced by tensor traversal and gradient resolution.

operator_chain.name: Implied Memory
operator_chain.definition: The memory target implied by a question, prompt, or conversational framing.

operator_chain.name: Confidence
operator_chain.definition: The practical feeling that the recall resolution is right.

canonical_flow.expression: RT ⊃ κ → O → S → τ → ρ → (M, C)
canonical_flow.conditioned_expression: RT ⊃ κ(m) → O(M|m) → S → τ → ρ → (M, C)
canonical_flow.interpretation: The comparison is a local operation inside RT by which RT is inferred, not produced.

notes: Orientation is not treated as arbitrary input.
Confidence is the felt/practical side of local resolution.
RT remains the whole expression and cannot be reduced to any local comparison.
